source.name: Oblivious
source.originalDescription: Reduces the duration of hindrances inflicted on the user by an increased amount. When a hindrance is inflicted on Bounsweet, Steenee; decrease the duration of the effect.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Oblivious には、直接ダメージや単純移動以外の特殊効果を検出していません。

source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, lunging at an opposing Pokémon, damage nearby opposing Pokémon and lowering the Defense of those hit by 20% for 1s.

source.name: Razor Leaf
source.originalDescription: The user pelts sharp-edged leaves in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit up to 3 times. The critical-hit rate of this move is increased by 15%. Pelts leaves in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. The critical-hit rate of this move is higher than that of basic attacks.

source.name: Rapid Spin
source.originalDescription: The user dashes forward and spins, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path and increasing the user's movement speed by 30% for 1.5s when it hits. Tsareena spins in the designated direction, dealing damage to any enemy hit. When this move hits, increase Tsareena's movement speed for a short time.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Rapid Spin には、直接ダメージや単純移動以外の特殊効果を検出していません。

source.name: Queen Ascendant
source.originalDescription: Tsareena leaps toward an enemy player and kicks it high into the air before showering it with a series of kicks while airborne, dealing damage to them. The moment Tsareena lands on the ground, recover HP. While airborne, the enemy that is being kicked and Tsareena are not affected by other moves. Tsareena leaps toward an enemy from the opposing team and kicks it high into the air before showering it with a series of kicks while airborne, dealing damage to them. The moment Tsareena lands on the ground, recover HP. While airborne, the enemy that is being kicked and Tsareena are not affected by other moves. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
